target_scope: all discoverable active association-football clubs in national league pyramids worldwide; historical clubs as optional legacy records

sources.name: OpenFootball clubs
sources.role: club and stadium discovery by country/continent
sources.limitations: Coverage is broad but incomplete; CC0 does not waive trademark rights.

sources.name: OpenFootball leagues
sources.limitations: Competition coverage and seasons vary by country.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.role: global entity discovery and geographic cross-reference
sources.limitations: Items may be historical, incomplete, duplicated or misclassified; Commons media has separate licenses.

sources.name: Football Origins
sources.role: discovery of Wikidata-derived historic club records
sources.limitations: Do not import until repository license is confirmed.

sources.role: Brazil 2026 Série A, B and C membership

sources.role: Germany 2026/27 Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga and 3. Liga membership

sources.name: Foot France
sources.role: France 2026/27 Ligue 1, Ligue 2 and Ligue 3 membership

source_audit.note: Source repositories and country-level files mapped. Club files contain historical/reserve entries and player files are nationality discovery lists, not current club rosters.

generation.note: Only use verified season-specific club membership and explicit player-to-club roster evidence. Synthetic fallback players are clearly marked and must not be confused with real players.

coverage.cuba_first_division_rosters: 16 clubs x 22 fictional profiles saved statically in data/players/cuba_first_division.json (352); four transferred clubs and their 88 player profiles are preserved in Tercera.
coverage.godot_integration: Static roster and club importers wired into FootballDataService; Godot runtime execution still pending.
coverage.usa_fictional_rosters_runtime_generated: 72 clubs x 22 profiles (1,584) saved statically in data/players/usa_base_2026.json; not generated at runtime.
coverage.usa_custom_schedules: pending; official formats are 34 MLS, 30 USL Championship, 32 USL League One matches
coverage.base_game_player_profiles: Fictional generated profiles; not real-world professional squads.
coverage.base_game_roster_files: data/players/*_base_*.json plus existing England and Cuba datasets
